ketmix.requested_by_owner: 2026-11-15: Automix works but must be more than a plain fade from one title to the next, with an analysis on the phone's processor in three settings, results in the style of Apple Music, researched from positive and negative reviews of other apps' automix, under the name Ketmix (BETA); its button at the left end of the bar under the transport.

research.how: one background research agent; it could not open any page directly (hosts not allowed in this environment), so everything comes from search-engine extracts of the listed pages and quoted fragments were not checked against the originals
what_listeners_dislike: titles shortened (the dominant complaint about Apple Music AutoMix, Spotify Automix and AI DJ, djay)
transitions at the wrong moment (endings and false endings)
audible tempo changes on mismatched pairs
the same effect on every transition
applied: never over a sung line and never past the last one (already there, from synced lyrics)
tempo tolerance tightened to 4/6/8 %, each title stretched only while it is the quiet one
less of an ending left out (0/16/45 s)
a fallback ladder: in time, echo out, crossing of filters or dissolve, cut on the beat, plain fade
key read and clashes kept short
two colours per kind that alternate
BPM and key shown in the status line

tested_on_host: the planner on hand-built analyses: every kind, the limits by setting, keys, alternation, the fallbacks without processors or without beats (TransitionPlannerTest, 22 tests)

level, filter, echo and reverb curves of every kind and the signal processing itself on synthetic signals: low-pass and high-pass responses, echo repeats that decay after the cut, a reverb tail that fades without overload, no click when a filter joins (DeckDspTest)
key detection on synthetic chord progressions in five keys, noise and silence; the wheel positions and which keys go together (MusicalKeyTest)
the three analysis settings and when a kept analysis is read again; a tempo that does not hold (BeatAnalysisTest, MusicalKeyTest)
the wording of every status line in the ten languages, the switch in the bar and in the wide queue, the settings (host tests)
never_run_with_real_audio: nothing of the engine was executed against real audio output on any device or emulator: none of the new transitions was listened to
the echo, the reverb and the filters were only measured on synthetic signals, never heard on music
the meeting of two tempos changes the speed of both decks every half second during a mix; whether those steps are inaudible on a device is not verified
key detection on real music (the method, chroma against Krumhansl-Kessler profiles, is known to confuse related keys; a wrong key only shortens or lengthens a mix)
the claim that this is better than other apps' automix is the owner's goal, not something that was measured
safeguards: off by default; any seek, title change, error, missing analysis or lack of time gives up the transition and the title ends as before
if the decks' processors are not in the sound path or the clock cannot be confirmed, only a trim or a plain crossfade on the decks' volume is used
a transition that is given up before the hand-over gives the outgoing title its own speed and level back

owner_section_changes: Framing screen: two modes, the album page and the music player alone; in the player's mode the rectangle keeps the shape of the player's artwork and is published as the player's own framing.
The music player now follows an album's framing (its own, else the page's) and the owner's Canvas switch (its own, else the page's).
Studio Canvas actions: a mode for the music player alone (hide, show, follow the album page), per ticked titles or for the whole album.
Server: the override row gains a nullable player column; POST /admin/override accepts player {frame, canvas}.
known_limitations: Owner-section changes are deliberately not mentioned in the public release notes (owner preference).
Ketmix needs the next title to be playable without a new resolution or one that succeeds in time; otherwise it says so and the title ends as before.
Ketmix does not mix into titles added by Autoplay at the end of the queue, nor a title whose source was chosen by hand.
A manual skip is still a plain change of title: it is not mixed.
The player's framing made on one screen shape is cropped to fit another (the rectangle covers the artwork).
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
